title: Steel Mezzanine Floor for Haier, 32,400 Sq Ft | Steel Mind
description: Steel Mind built a 32,400 sq ft steel mezzanine floor for Haier at Raiwind: 12 ft high, 180 ft wide and 180 ft long.
keyword: steel mezzanine floor project in Pakistan
h1: Steel Mezzanine Floor for Haier at Raiwind: 32,400 Square Feet of Added Floor Area
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. fabricated and erected a steel mezzanine floor for Haier at Raiwind, Lahore. The floor is 12 feet high, 180 feet wide and 180 feet long and covers 32,400 square feet.
alt: Large steel mezzanine floor built by Steel Mind for Haier at Raiwind.

faq.q: How big is the Haier mezzanine floor?
faq.a: It covers 32,400 square feet and stands 12 feet high.

faq.q: Can a mezzanine be built inside an existing building?
faq.a: Often yes, after an engineer checks the building.

blocks.text: A mezzanine adds floor area inside a building without a larger footprint. This floor is one of the largest stand-alone mezzanines Steel Mind has built. Columns, beams and deck were designed for the loads of their use, fabricated in Lahore and erected on site.

A floor of this size needs a clear plan for columns, so they do not block movement below. Beams and joists carry the deck. Stairs and handrails give safe access. The engineer sets the floor load from the heaviest item that will stand on it.
Steel Mind can build mezzanines at factory scale and not only small office floors.
